items.title: Craft Ammo at a Workbench
items.detail: Build a Tinker's Workbench in your C.A.M.P. or use one at Whitespring Resort

items.title: Build a Trap in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Place any trap in Defense menu; Punji Board is cheap at 4 steel and 8 wood

items.title: Collect Soap
items.detail: Find at Whitespring Resort in the red brick building behind main building or use Whitespring Robo Butler Collectron

items.title: Craft or Scrap a Melee Weapon
items.detail: Craft or scrap any melee weapon at a workbench

items.title: Deal a Critical Hit to a Radtoad in VATS
items.detail: Head to Grafton by the toxic river; use V.A.T.S. targeting the head

items.title: Eat a box of Sugar Bombs
items.detail: Find at New River Gorge Bridge - West or from Santatron/Fasnacht Collectron

items.title: Take a Camera Picture of a Super Mutant
items.detail: Fast travel to West Tek Research Center and photograph a Super Mutant

items.title: Collect a Fuel Tank or Gas Canister
items.detail: Found at industrial and roadside locations like Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go or Grafton Steel

items.title: Complete a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Easier with a team; join a Daily Ops public team and complete the instance

items.title: Craft any Plushie at a Tinkerer's Bench
items.detail: Build a Tinkerer's Bench in C.A.M.P. or use the one at Whitespring Resort

items.title: Cripple a Spooky Scorched's Leg
items.detail: Fast travel to Morgantown Airport; Spooky Scorched spawn during the seasonal event

items.title: Drink Nuka-Grape
items.detail: Get from Nuka-Cola Collectron Station in a C.A.M.P.

items.title: Drink Nuka-Orange
items.detail: Get from Nuka-Cola Collectron Station in a C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill a Creature
items.detail: Feral Ghouls at Whitespring Golf Club are easy targets

items.title: Kill a Creature while Wearing a Costume
items.detail: Equip any costume; Poseidon Energy Plant Yard is reliable for Scorched spawns

items.title: Take a Chem
items.detail: Get Chems from Doctor's Orders Cigarette Machine in a C.A.M.P.

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Earn the daily Gold Star on three separate days during the week
